name: AIBadge
summary: Inline 'AI generated' / 'AI summary' / 'AI confidence' label. Three flavors — badge (small chip), confidence (with 0-100 score), thinking (with the AI-shimmer + a typing indicator). Mandatory next to any text or value derived from AI inference, so users can tell what's machine-authored.

score.description: kind='confidence' only. 0-100. Renders a ring or pill with the score.

rules: AIBadge MUST sit adjacent to the AI-derived content — putting it remote from the content defeats its purpose.
aria-label spells out the meaning ('AI generated content, 92% confidence', not just '92%').
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: drop the AI shimmer and the thinking-dots animation.

do: Place AIBadge inline with the AI-authored text, not in a remote header.
Use confidence on values pulled from an LLM-extracted record.
Use thinking during the inference window (replaces an unlabeled Spinner).
dont: Don't render AI-derived content WITHOUT an AIBadge nearby.
Don't paint AIBadge in danger red — confidence below threshold is still a signal, not a failure.

changelog.note: Initial AIBadge contract. Four kinds — generated / summary / confidence / thinking.
